mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only. No desktop, native-window, file-dialog or screenshot-preview launches.

hover_gui.scope: Existing color-well, dropdown and availability hover checks pass, including one Magnifier explanation at display scales 1 and 2. Menu-path wording uses supported plain text.

limits: The Tools Magnifier preview no longer substitutes fit-to-window for an interactive magnifier. The status/View fit operation remains working and is exercised by existing zoom/pixel-mapping and tool-panel tests. Disabled clicks preserve the canvas view and document. Brush gallery rows now stay frameless while inactive, show hover feedback and outline the selected working tip; existing Round/Square selections and unavailable media remain unchanged. Samples are UI illustrations, not document rasterization evidence. Magnifier/media execution and native/rendered parity remain open.
